n: On May 15, 1829, on the bank of the Susquehanna River, John the Baptist appeared as a resurrected messenger and conferred the Aaronic Priesthood on Joseph Smith and Oliver Cowdery. It holds the keys of angelic ministry, repentance, and baptism by immersion, and will remain on earth until the sons of Levi again offer a righteous offering.

f.g: John the Baptist speaks humbly as a co-worker, not a superior.

f.w: the sons of Levi do offer again an offering unto the Lord in righteousness
